# Engineering Task Shape Analysis — `superseriousbusiness/gotosocial` @ `3722d12`

Stratum: **policy_control** (federation admission, relay filtering, domain permissions, content visibility rules)

---

## 1. Feature

The dominant task shape in this window. Several interlocking, net-new subsystems were landed:

### 1a. Relay infrastructure (subscription + push + actor)

The most substantial feature cluster, assembled across multiple sequential commits:

| Commit | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `39ad509` ([#4796](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4796)) | DB tables + models + API endpoints for `RelayPush`, `RelaySubscription`, `RelayMatcher`; settings-panel sections |
| `12e6d0c` ([#4810](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4810)) | Incoming federation side effects — dereference + store statuses from relay actors |
| `b765e74` ([#4820](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4820)) | Forward outgoing creates/updates/deletes to push relays |
| `8737f05` ([#4880](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4880)) | Auto-unfollow relay actor when all connections are removed |
| `413bafe` ([#4948](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4948)) | Relay actor DB migration, models, `IsLocalUserAccount()` nil-guard |
| `ee8e491` ([#4949](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4949)) | `/api/v1/accounts/{id}/remove_from_followers` + Allow remotes to Reject a Follow |

The core policy model is in [`internal/gtsmodel/relay.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/superseriousbusiness-gotosocial@3722d124433d2087a97f68689fea934610703783/-/blob/internal/gtsmodel/relay.go): three entities (`RelayPush`, `RelaySubscription`, `RelayActor`), each carrying a `RelayFlags` bitfield that encodes the content-admission policy (`Public`, `Unlisted`, `MatchByDefault`, `IgnoreSensitive`, `IgnoreMedia`, `IgnoreReplies`) and a `[]*RelayMatcher` slice for include/exclude regex matching.

Filtering logic sits in [`internal/filter/relay/relay.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/superseriousbusiness-gotosocial@3722d124433d2087a97f68689fea934610703783/-/blob/internal/filter/relay/relay.go): `matchedByConnection` (line 159) is the predicate that gate-keeps both inbound subscription admission and outbound push targeting. It checks visibility flags first, then runs exclude-matchers before include-matchers, with a `MatchByDefault` short-circuit.

CRUD processing lives in [`internal/processing/relaypush/relaypush.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/superseriousbusiness-gotosocial@3722d124433d2087a97f68689fea934610703783/-/blob/internal/processing/relaypush/relaypush.go) (`RelayPushCreate/Update/Delete`, `MatcherCreate/Update/Delete`).

### 1b. Domain permission subscription scheduler

[`internal/subscriptions/domainperms.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/superseriousbusiness-gotosocial@3722d124433d2087a97f68689fea934610703783/-/blob/internal/subscriptions/domainperms.go) implements a scheduled job (`ScheduleJobs`, line 49) that fetches remote blocklist/allowlist feeds (CSV / JSON / plain text), applies priority ordering, orphan-adoption, and retraction logic — all as automated policy enforcement. Commit `cc1316b` ([#4741](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4741)) was the major landing.

### 1c. Storage of delivery errors + admin overview

Commit `cc1316b` ([#4741](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4741)) also: reworks the `instances` table, adds `instance_settings`, passes a DB connection into delivery workers for per-delivery error persistence. Commit `603c849` ([#4818](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4818)) adds a button to clear those errors.

### 1d. Further isolated features

- `bae8f07` ([#4814](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4814)) — statuses multi-GET endpoint + dereferencer hooks for timelining/notifying  
- `cc3af19` ([#4833](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4833)) — sort access tokens by `last_used`; per-token name field

- `4e2589b` ([#4730](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4730)) — expose nearly all `http.Client{}`/`http.Server{}` options as config  
- `85050ee` ([#4798](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4798)) — serve instance actor AP representation without auth  
- `a2266f2` ([#4808](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4808)) — cleanup of old remote status threads (cleaner task)

## 3. Refactor

### 3a. Gin framework removal

The largest single-commit code movement in the window. Commit `62b3c42` ([#4847](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4847)) replaced `github.com/gin-gonic/gin` with a bespoke HTTP router built atop `net/http` and `code.superseriousbusiness.org/gopkg/httputil`. ### 3b. `internal/api/activitypub/users` → `actors` rename + `PathPrefix` abstraction

Commit `ccb583c` ([#4945](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4945)) moved the package and introduced `PathComponent` (`UsersPath`/`RelaysPath`) into [`internal/uris/uri.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/superseriousbusiness-gotosocial@3722d124433d2087a97f68689fea934610703783/-/blob/internal/uris/uri.go) to generalize URI generation. `Account.PathPrefix()` in [`internal/gtsmodel/account.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/superseriousbusiness-gotosocial@3722d124433d2087a97f68689fea934610703783/-/blob/internal/gtsmodel/account.go?L338-L344) dispatches on the `RelayUsernamePrefix` convention.

### 3c. AP property strictness consolidation

Commit `867ce73` ([#4905](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4905)) removed duplicate property-access logic in `internal/ap`, consolidating into `properties.go` with uniform `GetOne___()` interfaces. Secondary effect: sites across the codebase were updated to use the stricter single-value accessors.

### 3d. Config struct separation

Commit `4a0f116` ([#4946](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4946)) extracted `DatabaseConfiguration` into its own struct and split per-struct logic in the config helper generator. This was prerequisite scaffolding for the `database-transfer` tool, but is structurally a refactor of the config package.

### 3e. `instances` table rework

Commit `cc1316b` ([#4741](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4741)) restructured the `instances` table (removed unused columns, added delivery error fields, separated local instance settings into `instance_settings`). Behaviour-changing at the DB layer but the motivation was enabling delivery-error storage rather than pure cleanup.

## 3. Refactor

### 3a. Gin framework removal

The largest single-commit code movement in the window. Commit `62b3c42` ([#4847](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4847)) replaced `github.com/gin-gonic/gin` with a bespoke HTTP router built atop `net/http` and `code.superseriousbusiness.org/gopkg/httputil`. The commit message notes "590k deleted lines." Commit `8b57a24` ([#4941](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4941)) completed the final phase, migrating `gin`'s form-binding/mapping logic into `gopkg/httputil`.

This is a **refactor** (behavior-preserving intent) rather than a dependency migration because the replacement was custom-written, not an existing library swap.

### 3b. `internal/api/activitypub/users` → `actors` rename + `PathPrefix` abstraction

Commit `ccb583c` ([#4945](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4945)) moved the package and introduced `PathComponent` (`UsersPath`/`RelaysPath`) into [`internal/uris/uri.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/superseriousbusiness-gotosocial@3722d124433d2087a97f68689fea934610703783/-/blob/internal/uris/uri.go) to generalize URI generation. `Account.PathPrefix()` in [`internal/gtsmodel/account.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/superseriousbusiness-gotosocial@3722d124433d2087a97f68689fea934610703783/-/blob/internal/gtsmodel/account.go?L338-L344) dispatches on the `RelayUsernamePrefix` convention.

### 3c. AP property strictness consolidation

Commit `867ce73` ([#4905](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4905)) removed duplicate property-access logic in `internal/ap`, consolidating into `properties.go` with uniform `GetOne___()` interfaces. Secondary effect: sites across the codebase were updated to use the stricter single-value accessors.

### 3d. Config struct separation

Commit `4a0f116` ([#4946](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4946)) extracted `DatabaseConfiguration` into its own struct and split per-struct logic in the config helper generator. This was prerequisite scaffolding for the `database-transfer` tool, but is structurally a refactor of the config package.

### 3e. `instances` table rework

Commit `cc1316b` ([#4741](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4741)) restructured the `instances` table (removed unused columns, added delivery error fields, separated local instance settings into `instance_settings`). Behaviour-changing at the DB layer but the motivation was enabling delivery-error storage rather than pure cleanup.

## 8. Tooling / Operator Utility (proposed taxonomy note)

Two commits do not fit comfortably in the standard eight categories:

- **`4a0f116`** ([#4946](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4946)) — `cmd/database-transfer`: a standalone binary ([`cmd/database-transfer/main.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/superseriousbusiness-gotosocial@3722d124433d2087a97f68689fea934610703783/-/blob/cmd/database-transfer/main.go)) that migrates data between SQLite and Postgres. It is neither a product feature (not user-facing via the API) nor a test, refactor, or documentation change.
- **`b3573df`** ([#4940](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4940)) — `cmd/sqlite-repl`: a SQLite REPL under `cmd/sqlite-repl/` for interactive DB inspection.
- **`77059b4`** ([#4726](https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/pulls/4726)) — `sqlite cli commands` for DB administration operations.

**Proposed refinement:** Add **operator tooling** as a ninth category, distinct from *feature* (end-user) and *documentation/configuration* (config files). These are runnable binaries whose intended audience is instance operators performing maintenance. They include tests (`cmd/database-transfer/main_test.go`), but test generation alone does not describe them.
